description: Pre-share leak check ($0.005 USDC via x402). Before an agent posts, emails, or publishes text, scan it (or an https text URL) for leak-shaped strings (emails, coordinates, IPs, AWS/GitHub/Slack/sk- keys, private keys, JWTs) and for your own private terms, sent as a plain list or as salted hashes per call and not kept after the call. Returns JSON hits with line numbers so the agent can redact before sending. Max 10 MB, https only; binary URLs listed as unscanned. A clean scan is not a clearance. As is, no warranty. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

detectors.description: Leak-shaped string detectors (email, keys, tokens, IPs, coordinates). Default true.

hashed.description: Salted-hash list: hash = sha256_hex(salt + '\x00' + normalized_term). Sent per call, never stored.

terms.description: Plain terms to keep out (max 2000). Whole word/phrase, case- and accent-insensitive.

text.description: Text to scan (max 10 MB). Use this or url.

url.description: https URL of a text resource. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: sharescan
